\begin{example} \end{example} Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0037, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0038 1. Example 2.4\group eternal-solutions

Hamilton's cigar soliton is the complete surface $(\R ^2,g_\Sigma )$ with \[ g_\Sigma =\frac{dx\otimes dx+dy\otimes dy}{1+x^2+y^2} =\frac{dr^2+r^2\, d\theta ^2}{1+r^2} =ds^2+\tanh ^2(s)\, d\theta ^2, \] scalar curvature $R_\Sigma =\frac{4}{1+r^2}=\frac{4}{\cosh ^2 s}$, and area form $\frac{1}{1+r^2}\, dx\wedge dy$. It is asymptotic to a cylinder of radius $1$ with exponential decay. \end{example}
